item.title: Pope Leo XIV delivers first Christmas address with calls for compassion and dialogue to end global conflicts
item.description: Pope Leo XIV delivered his first Christmas address as pontiff to issue a sweeping appeal for empathy, peace and international cooperation, focusing repeatedly on the suffering caused by war, poverty and displacement, particularly in Gaza and Ukraine.
